title: SEC Insider Trading Scraper - Form 4 Insider Trades & Buys
description: Scrape SEC EDGAR Form 3/4/5 insider trades — buys and sells — from the official filings: one flat row per transaction with insider name, role, decoded code, shares, price, signed USD value and shares held after. No API key, no start fee.
